<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-GW-011</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Gateway</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Gateway&#x27;s local web page (port 8642); gateway log</b></div></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>the default password from the network, refused</span></div>

## Why it happens

The default password works only on the gateway machine itself, so a new gateway is not open to the network.

## Fix it

Sign in once on the gateway machine and set your own password. A forgotten password is reset on the gateway machine with `sentient-gateway --ui-password -` (Docker: `docker exec -it st-gateway sentient-gateway --ui-password -`). The password needs at least 8 characters.

## Check that it worked

You can sign in from another computer with the new password.
